Lower Text: [When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞.
Upper Text: This card may digivolve from the hand onto one of your yellow Tamers as if that card is a level 3 yellow Digimon.

[When Digivolving] If [KendoGarurumon] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards or you have a black or purple Digimon or Tamer, this Digimon may digivolve into [AncientGarurumon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring its digivolution requirements. If this effect digivolved, delete this Digimon at the end of this turn.
